If the language's time_ago/onset semantics are as they read, no patient within 6 weeks would match.

Header context 'postnatal patient (within 6 weeks of delivery)' is encoded with the time comparison reversed. Per will-briefing 'Time-based criteria', (>= (onset X) (time_ago N)) means onset at least N ago and (< (onset X) (time_ago N)) means within N. The rules use (<= (onset Postpartum state) (time_ago 6 weeks)), which means postpartum onset AT LEAST 6 weeks ago, so the Urgent rule and the PPH rule fire only outside the 6-week window and never inside it. Should be (< ... (time_ago 6 weeks)) or (>= (time_ago ...)) form. The 'Postpartum state' presenting complaint itself (86569001) is a reasonable choice.
